description: Read a weekly payer follow-up with the account ID and the access token returned when it was started: whether payment is settled, each application's status (not_checked, received, in_review, needs_documents, approved with its effective date, denied, no_record), whether we write and submit it (work: write_and_submit, with submitted_on empty until it is submitted) or it was already submitted (work: follow_up), the payer's reference or representative, missing documents, the last and next check, and the log of every check (date, method, who checked, what the payer said); the roster's changes from weekly monitoring; and the deadlines within 30 and 90 days.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed status link.

name: payer_follow_up_status
title: Read a weekly payer follow-up
